paragraphs: Chapter 652
Episode 165. After the Shock (6)
Valeria Hister, her colleagues last saw her about two months ago.
While it wasn't the first time she had been out of touch for so long, it was unlikely she wouldn't have reached out after news spread that Jin had returned to the world.

Most importantly, Rosa had announced the discovery of an artifact of the ancient household, which was used to draw Jin into the Garden of Swords. The summoned Padler was presumed to be a guardian who had guarded the fifth tomb of Temar.
All the clues were indicating there was a problem with her.
"I'm not sure why you're asking about your ally from us, 12th batch. Have you lost contact with Hister survivors too?"
"Yes."
Under normal circumstances, Jin would never have asked Zipfel about Valeria.
But now wasn't the time to be picky.
Upon hearing this, Ronil sighed, and Octavia held her forehead.
"Judging by your reactions, it seems you guys don't know either."
"Yes, we don't."
"But we still need to verify. Yuria."
Using the power of truth, a blue thread appeared between Ronil, Octavia, and Yuria. Just when Jin was about to express disappointment, Ronil offered some new information.
"However, we do know the area where the Hister survivors are believed to have last disappeared."
For a thousand years, Zipfel had been tracking Temar's tomb.
This time was no different. While Valeria was exploring, Zipfel was also seeking Temar's tomb.
"Where is that?"
Ronil exchanged glances with Octavia. Octavia seemed to nod, indicating it was fine to tell.
"It's a cave in Calderan, the Eastern 5th area of Huphester. When we arrived there, there were traces of record magic being used."
"You mean the Hister survivor left traces?"
"Yes, a blue window of record magic remained inside the cave."
"You saw the blue window firsthand?"
"...Yes, I was personally tracking the Hister survivor."
The Valeria Jin knew wouldn't have made such a sloppy mistake unless she intentionally set a trap or distraction.
"Can you elaborate on the situation at the time?"

"I confirmed the location of the Hister survivor from afar and followed her. Given that we were inside the Eastern 5th area, both the Hister survivor and I had many limitations on movement. I pursued her for about three days in the Calderan tundra, and she entered a cave with only one entrance and exit."
"And she disappeared, leaving behind a blue window of record magic?"

"Yes, that's all there was. There were no signs of escape in the cave. I wondered if the Hister survivor had learned invisibility or teleportation magic from the ancestral land, but there were no signs of any magic used except for the record magic."
"People can't just disappear like that without a Frog Mort, right?"
"So we thought a Mort rescued the Hister survivor. After all, Hidden Palace is no longer neutral, it's essentially an ally of the Order."
"Did you continue to investigate the cave in Calderan afterwards?"
"We couldn't. Right after that, the 3rd batch of Runcandel started guarding the place."
"Anyway, I really need to leave now. If there's any progress, I'll send a letter to Tikan. Maybe soon, your sister might find a little clue about the fifth tomb of Temar."
Those were the words Valeria had said before she left for Lafrarosa.
Luntia had been tracking Temar's tomb for a long time.
Also, she was one of the three brothers who didn't know about Jin's 'current state'.

"Circumstantially, there is a high possibility that the 3rd batch of Runcandel also knew the location of the Hister survivor. No, it's certain. The 3rd batch and knights were centered exactly around that cave."
Hoo.
Jin held back his feelings and sighed.
The Mary and Tona brothers, and the dead Jorden and the surviving rebels didn't know about Luntia either.
Even Diphus had to step in to handle the aftermath of the Gliek subjugation, replacing Luntia, who was the highest-ranking.
'Sure enough, is Sister Luntia... immersed in chaos?'
Although they hadn't met, they all expected Luntia's condition to be so.
If not, there would be no reason for her not to encounter the rebels.
"Knight Ronil, didn't you encounter my sister Luntia?"
"I couldn't confirm the 3rd batch closely because the situation was urgent. However, the Calderan tundra was full of knights immersed in chaos."
Yuria confirmed all of Ronil's words to be true.
Luntia's erosion was almost certain.
"What is the possibility that the Hister survivor was kidnapped by Sister Luntia?"
"If the 3rd batch found something I didn't find in that cave that day, it's not impossible."
Jin looked at Orgal. Orgal smiled as if he understood why.
"Why, do you doubt my dimensional movement ability? We also know nothing about the survivor of Hister."
When Yuria checked the siblings of Iblisiano, they were indeed clueless.
'If Zipfel and Kinzelo don't know, then Valeria hasn't been caught.'
Jin felt such certainty.
"If Rosa had secured my mentor, she would have already threatened me through him. She should have used my mentor more even after calling me to the Garden of Swords."
In the Garden of Swords, Rosa made no additional remarks about Valeria.
There were things Jin did not ask, but the decisive reason was that she had no way to exploit her.
Of course, Jin and the enormous forces gathered here were not the only ones in the world tracking the Tomb of Temar.
The royal family, the owners of Temar's left arm, were also looking for the tomb.
'But if the royal family had captured Valeria, Zipfel would know. Unless they backstab Zipfel and side with Runcandel...'
Jin decided to ask outright.
"Lord Ronil, is Zipfel's relationship with the royal family still the same?"
"The royal family does not have the ability to capture the survivor of Hister. Even less so without our family knowing."

"Jin, you seem obsessed with the survivor of Hister. You wouldn't want to restore my history through the survivor of Hister, or use Zipfel's history manipulation to strike at the Garden of Swords, would you?"
"Do you think I'd have such a disgusting thought? She's my comrade."
At Orgal's words, Jin revealed a bit of anger.
"Anyway, it seems like you're going to be bloodshot about finding her for a while."
"That issue is for me to deal with. Now it might be good to return to the story of the Garden of Swords."
"No, this is about the Garden of Swords, Jin. Have you forgotten? You are the only opposition to Rosa Runcandel at this point. It means you shouldn't act rashly."

"…In this regard, I agree with Lord Orgal, 12th Order. If you're looking for the survivor of Hister now, you'll obviously visit the Eastern 5 areas first, won't you? I suppose you know better than anyone what condition Huphester is in now."

"Zipfel and Kinzelo are worried about me. Especially Zipfel worrying more about Hister's safety than I do... It's unfamiliar. Of course, I want to save Hister not only because she's my comrade, but also to oppose the Garden of Swords. It's not just you who needs her abilities."
"You're going to further develop the space-time device you stole from us."
"It's embarrassing when you say it like that."
"There's no need for that. It's our family's failure to manage properly. But at this point, you should reconsider going to Huphester for Hister."
Ronil spoke as if devoid of emotion, but Jin heard his calm voice like this: I'll take it back someday.
'Zipfel has other means besides history manipulation. If Orgal pays some price, Kinzelo could surely accelerate recovery.'
Yuria's Authority of Truth is not yet perfect.
She can accurately distinguish between truth and lies, but it was a stretch to perceive 'multiple truths' that were not intentionally spoken.
Jin didn't think Zipfel and Kinzelo wouldn't know this, so he was sure there were parts they intentionally didn't mention.
"Yet, their concern for my well-being is because that's their best strategy.
Even if Yuria's power could reveal the truth hidden within, this is not the real thing, but a temporary alliance negotiation.
If we used our power that deeply, the negotiation would have been cancelled from the start.
'From their perspective, the best outcome is to use me to eliminate Rosa without showing their other hands.'
Rosa's powerlessness shown in the Garden of Swords this time was transcendent enough to be called a 'monstrosity.'
But when the day comes for Jin and the temporary alliance to have their final showdown with her, it will be undoubtedly more terrible than it is now.
Even if Jin could defeat Rosa.
We'll have to accept the damage. It was impossible to win over her without sustaining a fatal blow.
Of course, Zipfel and Kinzelo will also take a hit, but it's incomparable to Jin, who will face Rosa in a one-on-one fight.
What happens when the war ends?
Kinzelo and Zipfel will no longer be allies. Even if Jin wins the war against Rosa, there's a high probability that at his weakest moment, he will have the most powerful enemies by his side.
Of course, Jin had no such thoughts.
'They don't know that Valeria is not only the key to the space-time device but also the key to completing the golden fleet.'
One year.
It's not a long time, but Jin planned to prepare to stand against Rosa within that time, making the most of the remaining two forces.
"If you're so worried about me, assign me some people. I'm going to the Coldran Snowfield as soon as the negotiation ends."
"You mean to say so soon......?"
"To assign people……. That's an interesting request. I can feel your intention to exploit us to the bone until the temporary alliance ends."

"It's a matter of course. It doesn't matter if you don't give me people, I'm going alone anyway. As Orgal said earlier, Rosa will need at least a year to make a move again. I have to do everything I can within that time. To do that, Hister is absolutely necessary."
"I agree, Kinzelo!"
Margiella said with sparkling eyes, and Ronil nodded as if he had no choice.
"Zipfel will agree too."
"There's one person on Zipfel's side that I want."
"......Who are you thinking of?"
Jin met his eyes and replied.
"Veradin. Assign me Veradin Zipfel."
